bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
sha=15e86a1f7777ec537353d9284300cd5de61b6245
stage="$root/.worktrees/link-pr62-15e86a1"
test -d "$root/.git" || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 62
git -C "$root" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/chat/link-button-master-final-20261120
test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 63
if test -d "$stage"; then
  test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 64
  test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain)" || exit 65
else
  mkdir -p "$root/.worktrees"
  git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$stage" "$sha"
fi
test -f "$stage/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" || exit 66
docker build --pull=false -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr62-candidate -f "$stage/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" "$stage" >/tmp/gace-link62-build-log 2>&1 || { tail -n 16 /tmp/gace-link62-build-log >&2; exit 67; }
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr62-candidate >/dev/null
echo "PR62_CANDIDATE_IMAGE_BUILT=PASS"
echo "PRODUCTION_CONTAINER_UNTOUCHED=PASS"
